description: Header definitions for classes managing F1 Application Protocol (F1AP) UE bearer contexts in a 5G NR network, including specific bearer implementations for SRB0 and other SRBs, with methods for handling SDUs, PDUs, notifications, and delivery reports.

classes.name: f1c_srb0_du_bearer
classes.description: Manages the SRB0 bearer in the F1AP context, handling initial UL RRC message transfer, PDU handling, and notifications.

classes.name: f1c_other_srb_du_bearer
classes.description: Handles other SRB bearers, managing PDU transmission, delivery, and RRC delivery reports with support for asynchronous notification handling.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles the SDU (Service Data Unit) for UL RRC message transfer, packing and forwarding it.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Handles notification for the highest PDCP SN transmitted.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Handles notification for the highest PDCP SN delivered.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes incoming PDU, with optional RRC delivery status request.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_delivery
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for delivery confirmation asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_transmission
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for transmission asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_rrc_delivery_report
methods.description: Processes RRC delivery reports as per 3GPP TS 38.473.
